calculation_handling.description: A rear addition to a pre-October 15, 1953 detached house on a lot with a permitted FSI of 0.6 may bring the lot's overall FSI up to 0.69.

900.3.10(1430).explanation: Exception RD 1430 lets a pre-1953 detached house on a lot with a permitted FSI of 0.6 add a rear addition up to an overall FSI of 0.69 (subject to floor-level, side-wall and prior-addition-age conditions), requires upper-storey additions to meet normal setbacks, bars raised platforms from encroaching into front or rear yards, and bars front-wall vehicle entrances on lots with 7.6 m or less of frontage. Two sections of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 also prevail.

900.3.10(366).explanation: Exception RD 366 sets a 0.9 m minimum side setback, 3.6 m from a street-side lot line, 0.3 m for garages from an interior side lot line, and 22.0 m from the original street centreline on lots fronting Bellamy, Brimley, McCowan, Midland or Danforth.

900.3.10(367).explanation: Exception RD 367 fixes the minimum lot frontage and lot area at what existed when the by-law was enacted, and sets a 1.2 m minimum side setback, 3.6 m from a street-side lot line, 0.3 m for garages from an interior side lot line, and 22.0 m from the original street centreline on lots fronting Bellamy, Brimley, McCowan, Midland or Danforth.
